newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.64 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.64 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.70455 percent at 0330 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.88 percent at the previous tender on December 17.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue totalled HK$3.89 billion against HK$3.77 billion in the last tender.
The average accepted yield of 90-day bills was 4.46 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.60795 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.53 percent at the tender last week.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue was HK$3.68 billion, down from HK$5.75 billion at the pervious tender, HKMA said.
The authority also tendered HK$5 billion in 27-day bills, the roll-over of the second of three special one-month issues to faciliate the implementation of real-time gross settlement.
The average accepted yield of the bills was 4.34 percent with bids totalling HK$5.72 billion and against one-month HIBOR of 5.48295 percent.
This compared with an average accepted yield of 4.31 percent and bids of HK$6.81 billion for the HK$5 billion one-month issue tendered on December 24. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
